title: Verdier biduality for the dualizing complex
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum
and the coefficient
conventions, $A=A_{E,n}$, and let $Y$ be a
separated finite-type
$k$-scheme with
exceptionally admissible structure
morphism $a_Y$. For the dualizing
complex $\omega_{Y,A}$ and Verdier dual $D_Y$ of
[def-trf-dualizing-complex], let $M\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$.
Then there is a functorial isomorphism

$$
M\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }D_YD_YM,
$$

and the evaluation $\operatorname{ev}_M$ of
[def-trf-dualizing-complex] is the map

$$
\operatorname{ev}_M:D_YM\otimes_A^LM\to\omega_{Y,A}.
$$

proof.text: Work on the small pro-etale site, as prescribed by [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. Thus $n\geq1$, $\ell\ne p$, and $A=A_{E,n}$, with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$. By [def-trf-dualizing-complex], $\omega_{Y,A}=Ra_Y^!A_s$ and $D_Y=R\mathcal Hom_A(-,Ra_Y^!A_s)$. By [def-trf-admissibility], the specified right adjoint in the exceptional-admissibility hypothesis is the constructible exceptional inverse image of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Thus the exceptional functor here is precisely the finite-stage comparison-transport functor of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], restricted to the constructible category. Hence these are the same object and functor denoted $\omega_Y$ and $D_Y$ in finite-stage geometric biduality; $A$ there denotes the constant coefficient object on $s$. No comparison with a separately chosen dualizing object, and no ambient pro-etale adjoint assumption, is needed.

source.place: Proof, first two sentences: identify the coefficient category and dualizing object

proof.text: Apply the small pro-etale assertion of [thm-fix-general-biduality] to this $Y$, $A$, and $K=M$. Its hypotheses are exactly that $Y$ is separated of finite type over $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $A=A_{E,n}$, and $M\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$, all given here. Its anti-equivalence assertion ensures that $D_YM$ and $D_YD_YM$ belong to this same category, and its biduality assertion makes the natural morphism $\delta_M:M\to D_YD_YM$ invertible. Its stated naturality supplies the functorial isomorphism required in the item. The additional exceptional admissibility hypothesis of the item is retained; no boundary-duality hypothesis is introduced.

source.place: Proof, first sentence: specialize finite-stage geometric biduality

proof.text: By [def-trf-dualizing-complex], the inverse image of $\operatorname{id}_{D_YM}$ under the displayed tensor-internal-Hom adjunction is exactly $\operatorname{ev}_M:D_YM\otimes_A^LM\to\omega_{Y,A}$. By the pro-etale formal construction stated in [lem-weil-duality-pairing], its transpose is the natural double-dual morphism $\delta_M$ used above. More explicitly, compose the symmetry $M\otimes_A^LD_YM\to D_YM\otimes_A^LM$ with this evaluation and transpose with respect to the $D_YM$ variable; the result is $M\to R\mathcal Hom_A(D_YM,\omega_{Y,A})=D_YD_YM$. The dualizing object needed for that formal construction is already specified in step 1. Thus the isomorphism has the specified evaluation pairing, with the factor order displayed in the statement. The pairing is determined uniquely by the identity under the adjunction bijection, so no alternative evaluation is being chosen.

source.place: Proof, last sentence: the evaluation and its double-dual transpose
